answer: The raven counter is kept in echo and cedar shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2948 identities would post 952 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
